extraction.Name: Josephine Larvie, formerly Josephine Terry
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 28, 1921 by Tri County Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Deed from Josephine Larvie formerly Josephine Terry, and Joseph Larvie, dated June 22, 1921, conveys the land to W. H. Tackett for a consideration of $1500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739613 issued; Southwest quarter section 15, township 38, north of range [range number not legible]; receipt for patent was signed April 2, 1920 by the allottee
